steps.text: The main button offers the one action that matters now. The procedure being ready, it is "Send".
steps.title: Send

steps.text: OptimCE sends nothing itself. It prepares the recipient, the subject with its reference, a text to copy and the documents to attach; you send them from your mailbox or the regulator's online form.
steps.title: What to send

steps.text: Give the date and the channel, attach the email you sent if you like, then "Mark as sent". The procedure is then frozen: a change arriving later goes into a new procedure.
steps.title: Mark as sent

steps.text: Sending starts the CWaPE's completeness-check delay, counted in Walloon working days. The next action becomes "Add a response": that is where you record its acknowledgement or its request for more information.
steps.title: The regulator's delay is running

steps.text: Go back to the list of procedures.
steps.title: Back to the procedures

steps.text: The "Deadlines" tab gathers the delays of every procedure: yours as well as the regulator's or the grid operator's.
steps.title: Every deadline

steps.text: Every deadline says who has to act and by when; overdue ones rise to the top in red. It closes by itself when the expected response is recorded in the procedure.
steps.title: The deadline agenda

title: Send a procedure and follow its deadline
